name: Vitreous-Ria
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by towering mountain ranges. Beyond tectonic rift valleys, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
Nothing about radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
